title: Mushroom Molds
summary: More props for 'Silver Cord'. I 3D printed molds to make mushrooms from 2 part expanding foam. It worked really well. In the first version of Silver Cord I used real mushrooms, which looked good but didn't last very long. These things were bomb-proof. They were meant to look kinda rotty and gross.
